models.silhouette: A heavy quadruped cream-gray forest bear with very long dark forearms, tiny round ears and two huge stepped chestnut shelf-fungus plates growing horizontally from its shoulders. Short tail, four legs, broad hanging rectangular shoulder silhouette. Moss-green chin beard.

A lanky green-skinned biped orc with very long arms and two small tusks, high narrow woven reed helmet, short moss poncho, enormous square folded-leaf shield in left hand and a short hooked bone axe in right hand. Bare broad feet, rust trousers. Angular upright silhouette.

A muscular low slung dark chestnut quadruped wild boar with massive long forward-curving ivory tusks, pointed pinecone-shaped armored forehead, high spiked black dorsal mane tapering to tiny rear, small straight tail. Large front-heavy wedge silhouette, cloven hooves.

A lean quadruped silver wolf wearing a broken large brass clock dial as a tall circular collar around the shoulders. Long narrow muzzle, small triangular ears, long slender legs, thin tail curled into a near circular ring. Dark paws, teal copper straps. No wings.

A flying bat with slender burgundy body, very long narrow tapered plum-colored bat wings, enormous tall rectangular lattice-pattern ears resembling gothic screens, short hooked feet and a tiny tail. Pale ivory face and tarnished gold wing finger-struts. Bat membranes, no feathers.

A very round barrel-shaped ochre wild boar on four short teal-gray cloven legs, broad pink snout, short spade-shaped ivory tusks, large fan of three curled emerald fern fronds arching from the back, tiny curly tail and drooping round ears. Squat round silhouette.

A tall slender human ruin raider in a broad slate-blue triangular kettle helmet with long white plume, dark crimson split cloak, fitted gray leather tunic, narrow boots. Carries a short curved rust-red sword in right hand and small diamond-shaped turquoise shield in left hand. Clearly human, two arms and legs.

A low coiled pale sage-green viper with a very broad triangular head, two long curved wooden thorn horns over amber eyes, cream belly, dark diamond scale pattern and an acorn-shaped thorny tail club. No cobra hood. Low horizontal serpentine silhouette, no limbs.

sourcePolicy: Preserve originals and imagegen reflows. Mechanical complete-pose source rectangle registration, scaling and alpha compositing only; no alpha masking or anatomy synthesis.
